repair: At most one full-proposal or condition repair after a valid proposal and confirmed valid review failure. Invalid typed writer or reviewer output fails this case. Preserve uncertain calls without a new request ID.
source_selection: Use only historical originals both retrieved and published by the exact cutoff, published within 30 hours, from registered enabled use_for_summary sources with matching digest. Read at most 48 per origin and 600 total, then apply unchanged selection version 3 to at most 16 excerpts. No retrospective current lake or web search.
independent_check: Write source-by-source substantive notes after selecting originals but before viewing the writer response. Compare the final main post with those notes; model self-review alone is insufficient.
pass: Typed proposal and review valid, all twelve semantic checks true, reviewer verdict publish, no mechanical rejections, the absence of a newly completed US session stated accurately without inventing one, available market facts observed at their true timestamp or explicitly missing, no quote conflicts, and independent original-to-main-post check finds no material omission. Report actual elapsed model time separately from historical scheduled timing. This one offline date cannot qualify five-day live publication.
offline_scope: Actual cached originals and existing subscription writer/reviewer; no Slack post, no database mutation, no paid API key fallback.
